title: Commandos: Behind Enemy Lines
notes: Vault reads your save games (the OUTPUT folder in the game folder) and never touches the game.
Save a game once in each new mission (Esc, Save) and the mission before it counts as finished.
Untested: Vault hasn't seen a Commandos save yet, so if nothing pops after saving, send a test report.

testGuide.title: Start the campaign
testGuide.detail: Play the first mission for a minute, then save the game.

testGuide.title: Check the numbers
testGuide.detail: "Last save" should show the mission name. When you save in mission 2, the first mission pops.
